entities.name: Jerome B. Robertson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jerome Bonaparte Robertson was a doctor, soldier, and politician who served as a general in the Confederate States Army during the American Civil War. He was noted for his service in the famed Texas Brigade in the Army of Northern Virginia.
